body: Maganda ang scorecard ni Mika, pero may human question din: kapag mas measurable at automated ang laboratory, ano ang nangyayari sa tacit judgment ng experienced engineer? Hindi dapat romanticize ang manual work, pero hindi rin lahat ng expertise madaling gawing KPI. Ang magandang tanong sa vendors: kapag mali o ambiguous ang system, sino ang inaasahang makakapansin—at anong skill ang kailangan pa rin ng tao para makakontra sa machine? Automation should remove drudgery without quietly removing the capacity to judge it.

claims.text: As laboratory automation expands, preserving human capability to detect ambiguous or incorrect machine outputs is an important design and training question.
claims.basis: Reflection inference from the article's emphasis on AI, automated experiments, connected instruments and evidence validation
